    10  /-!
    11  # Fixed-point-free automorphisms
    12  
    13  This file defines fixed-point-free automorphisms and proves some basic properties.
    14  
    15  An automorphism `φ` of a group `G` is fixed-point-free if `1 : G` is the only fixed point of `φ`.
    16  -/
    17  
    18  @[expose] public section
    19  
    20  namespace MonoidHom
    21  
    22  variable {F G : Type*}
    23  
    24  section Definitions
    25  
    26  variable (φ : G → G)
    27  
    28  /-- A function `φ : G → G` is fixed-point-free if `1 : G` is the only fixed point of `φ`. -/
    29  def FixedPointFree [One G] := ∀ g, φ g = g → g = 1
    30  
    31  /-- The commutator map `g ↦ g / φ g`. If `φ g = h * g * h⁻¹`, then `g / φ g` is exactly the
    32    commutator `[g, h] = g * h * g⁻¹ * h⁻¹`. -/
    33  def commutatorMap [Div G] (g : G) := g / φ g
    34  
    35  @[simp] theorem commutatorMap_apply [Div G] (g : G) : commutatorMap φ g = g / φ g := rfl
    36  
    37  end Definitions
    38  
    39  namespace FixedPointFree
    40  variable [Group G] [FunLike F G G] [MonoidHomClass F G G] {φ : F}
    41  
    42  theorem commutatorMap_injective (hφ : FixedPointFree φ) : Function.Injective (commutatorMap φ) := by
    43    refine fun x y h ↦ inv_mul_eq_one.mp <| hφ _ ?_
    44    rwa [map_mul, map_inv, eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq, ← mul_assoc, ← eq_div_iff_mul_eq', ← division_def]
    45  
    46  variable [Finite G]
    47  
    48  theorem commutatorMap_surjective (hφ : FixedPointFree φ) : Function.Surjective (commutatorMap φ) :=
    49    Finite.surjective_of_injective hφ.commutatorMap_injective
    50
